migrate.title: Bring your existing set-up across
migrate.description:
We found an existing Smart Irrigation installation. Irrigation Plus can import its configuration — your zones, buckets, schedules, run history and weather settings, including your API key.

Important: leave the old Smart Irrigation integration in place until this finishes. Removing it first deletes its stored API key, which cannot be recovered afterwards.

leftover_legacy_directory.title: The old Smart Irrigation folder is still installed
leftover_legacy_directory.description:
Irrigation Plus now installs to its own folder, but the previous Smart Irrigation folder is still at `{path}`. HACS does not remove it when an integration changes folder, and Home Assistant will load it as a second integration — so you will see two of every sensor.

Delete that folder and restart Home Assistant. Your configuration has already been carried over.

foreign_legacy_install.title: Another irrigation integration shares this folder
foreign_legacy_install.description:
A different `smart_irrigation` integration is installed at `{path}`. That is fine — the two can run side by side, which is the point of the rename.

One thing to know: dashboards using the old `smart-irrigation-zones-card` type now belong to that integration, not this one. Switch them to `irrigation-plus-zones-card`.

leftover_legacy_directory_removable.title: Remove the old Smart Irrigation installation?

confirm.title: Remove the old installation
confirm.description:
Your configuration has been carried over, so what is left at `{path}` is the installation it came from. Home Assistant is still loading it as a second integration, which is why you see two of every sensor.

This removes both halves, in this order:

1. The **{name}** integration entry, together with its stored configuration. The copy taken during the migration is kept at `.storage/smart_irrigation.storage.pre-irrigation_plus.bak`.
2. The folder at `{path}`.

That order matters: removing the entry first lets Home Assistant shut the old integration down properly.

This cannot be undone from here. If you are not yet sure the migration is complete, close this and check your zones and history first.

done.title: Removed
done.description:
The old integration and its folder at `{path}` are gone.

**Restart Home Assistant** to finish. The duplicate entities disappear with that restart.

partial.title: The folder is still there
partial.description:
The old integration entry was removed, but the folder at `{path}` could not be deleted — almost always a file-permission problem. The reason is in the log.

Delete that folder yourself and restart Home Assistant. Until you do, Home Assistant keeps loading it.

unsafe.title: Not removing anything yet
unsafe.description:
This was not carried out, because the migration no longer looks complete: this integration currently has no zones.

Removing the old integration would delete the configuration at `.storage/smart_irrigation.storage`, which in that state is your only full copy. Nothing has been changed. Please open an issue rather than deleting `{path}` by hand.
